kinds.contradiction: documents disagreed; the build plan resolved it
kinds.citation: a reference was wrong or incomplete
kinds.retraction: a claim withdrawn (kept as a record)
kinds.addition: a measured phenomenon the earlier documents did not model

corrections.was: PRD 0.04 m; web 37 mm; v3 3.7 cm frontal with its own dorsal slope
corrections.now: 0.037 m frontal (JJE 1984: 3.7 cm, r^2 0.60 for 13 points). No measured dorsal value: tagged hypothesis until a fit exists. Linear by default, exponential as the labelled alternative.

corrections.was: PRD straw tint (0.86, 0.72, 0.46), tagged Aesthetic
corrections.now: Linen (0.445, 0.344, 0.240) linear sRGB under D65; image at h = 1 is linen x (0.881, 0.807, 0.725). Recomputed independently; agrees within 0.001.

corrections.was: PRD: each fibril is coloured or not; v3: colour is a smooth function of h
corrections.now: Both hold: coloured fraction f = h x f_max, and each coloured fibril takes the JJE colour at h = 1/f_max, so the average is exactly v3's.

corrections.was: PRD artist colours on painted masks; v3: slide-derived absolutes are about 2.4x too bright
corrections.now: Masks and ratios stay; absolute colours are re-derived relative to the JJE linen and stay assumptions until a measured spectrum is cited.

corrections.was: PRD 38.6 x 25.7 cited to Vial 1989; web 38.1 x 25.8 cited to Vial 1991; the 2026 fragment paper quotes 38 x 25-26
corrections.now: Vial 1989 main cloth: warp 38.3, weft 25.4 per cm; side strip 38.1 and 26.2. 38.6 x 25.7 is Raes 1973-74; 38.1 x 25.8 mixes the side strip's warp with the overall weft. The 2026 paper's own count is 37-41 x 26-29.

corrections.was: PRD 4.37 x 1.11 m cited to the 2002 restoration; web the same numbers cited to Flury-Lemberg 1998
corrections.now: 4.37 x 1.11 m is the size before the 2002 restoration (no Flury-Lemberg 1998 source found). After 2002: 4.415 x 1.137 m. Both kept, tied to the restoration-state switch; default pre-2002.

corrections.was: PRD reverses the diagonal every N weft rows (bands across the cloth); web reverses every 40 warp threads (bands along it)
corrections.now: The web is right: selvedges along both long edges, warp lengthwise, chevrons along the warp; a repeat is 41 threads one way and 39 back, so each band is about 1 cm.

corrections.was: Three bakers (PRD Rec.709 luma; port and web percentile), none masking blood, scorch or patches, so they become bumps
corrections.now: One offline JJE inversion with masks. This package ships a synthetic forward-model h (license-free) and, outside the public repo, a masked photo proxy; neither is the final inversion.

corrections.was: PRD: edge-enhanced sub-surface hypothesis view; v3: a physical X-radiograph from the endmember model
corrections.now: PRD mode renamed 'Sub-surface (hypothesis)'; X-radiograph added as its own mode.

corrections.was: v3 LOD 0-4 are scale levels (chapel to crystal); PRD LOD 0-3 are mesh levels
corrections.now: v3's become scale levels S0-S4. PRD LOD0 quads are 4.3 x 2.2 mm, not 8.5 mm.

corrections.was: v3 and the PoC have it; the PRD mode list does not
corrections.now: Added: T = exp(-(mu_cloth + mu_blood*blood + mu_scorch*scorch)*d), with no image term.

corrections.was: PRD v2 removed the Mandelbrot mode as meaningless; web v3 keeps a Fractal veil
corrections.now: Web only, labelled aesthetic; not ported.

corrections.was: PRD 8K square maps and a 2048 x 4096 compute grid; the cloth is 1 : 3.9
corrections.now: One grid, 2048 x 8192, for every map and the compute pass.

corrections.was: v3 section 6 says ship on URP 17 and 6.5
corrections.now: HagopJay's decision stands: 6.3 LTS (Unity work is parked in this package).

corrections.was: PRD CRTLookFeature and static palette PNGs versus the port's CRT feature and cycler
corrections.now: Merged as in the build plan's 'Which code survives' table (Unity form, not part of this package).

corrections.now: Fazio and Mandaglio 2008, Atti Accad. Peloritana 86(2); the dorsal range is 'arbitrary' there

corrections.now: Sci. Rep. 16:21206 (2026); samples are linen filaments, vacuum dust and a slide, not only dust

corrections.now: Add the Casabianca, Marinelli and Piana commentary and Moraes' reply (Archaeometry 68(4), 2026)

corrections.now: Exists; its abstract does not mention Mitsuba 3 and the full text is paywalled

corrections.was: PRD: 2-4 GW/cm^2 threshold, 24/48 J/cm^2 onset/saturation, a single 12 ns pulse of 57.6 J/cm^2 (4.8 GW/cm^2) 'inside the window'
corrections.now: Table 1: 200-600 pulses of 0.07-0.13 J/cm^2 at 6-13 MW/cm^2 per pulse, totals about 25-40 J/cm^2; 73 J/cm^2 ablated

corrections.was: 38 x 25-26 per cm attributed to the 2026 paper
corrections.now: Quoted from older work; the paper's own count is 37-41 x 26-29

Discard absolute values (about 2.4x too bright, too neutral): Ektachrome response, 45 years of dye fade, scanner and 8-bit JPEG are unknown transfer functions. Masks, ratios, thread geometry and frequency structure survive.
tint(h=1) = (0.881, 0.807, 0.725): red goes down, not up

corrections.was: Dorsal 11 % darker because pressed harder
corrections.now: Retracted: JJE found equal amplitudes at about 77x pressure difference (26.8 vs 0.35 g/cm^2); the 11 % gap was slide exposure. The dorsal slope differs (Fazio and Mandaglio 2008).

corrections.was: Porphyrin emission tiers; dense porphyrin (0.840, 0.101, 0.114)
corrections.now: Dried blood is non-fluorescent; serum margins fluoresce; background greenish; image dark; light scorch reddish. The false-colour face is a display mapping.

corrections.was: Blood-before-image proves authenticity
corrections.now: Ordering is fact; exclusivity is not proof (Kearse 2026).

corrections.was: Correspondence by X-ray micrography; 'pulmonary edema colour'
corrections.now: Photographic overlay (PIOT) and forensic (EDICES) evidence; 'consistent with'. The edema colour was measured on a Shroud slide.

corrections.was: 2.154 per mm (200 um guess)
corrections.now: 1.25 per mm with the 345 um JJE thickness; MFP 0.80 mm

corrections.was: 2.1 % (face mean on an 8-bit negative)
corrections.now: h = 1 gives -18 % Y; a face-region mean is a few percent. Report both.

corrections.was: Build the biophoton emitter on Unity's new custom lights
corrections.now: That API is 2D-only; keep the emitter as emissive geometry (Unity form, parked).

corrections.was: (not modelled)
corrections.now: The image is not discernible closer than about 1.8 m; its density range is about 22x the 0.004 threshold. Fall out of the weave scale naturally.
